hero.title: Uniworld vs Scenic River Cruises
hero.subtitle: Two Distinct Approaches to True All-Inclusive European River Cruising
hero.description: Comparing Uniworld Boutique River Cruises and Scenic Luxury River Cruises brings you to the top tier of all-inclusive European river travel. Both include virtually every expense—from unlimited premium beverages and guided excursions to gratuities and airport transfers—yet each delivers an entirely distinct ship atmosphere and butler experience.

intro.heading: Two Titans of All-Inclusive Luxury
intro.lead: Choosing between Uniworld and Scenic River Cruises means choosing between two of the most lavishly inclusive river cruise lines in the world. Neither nickel-and-dimes, and both provide world-class service, gourmet dining, and private butler hospitality.
paragraphs: Uniworld is famous for its boutique European palace styling. Every vessel in the Uniworld fleet is an individually curated masterpiece with one-of-a-kind antique furnishings, bespoke fabrics, Murano glass chandeliers, and curated artwork that reflects the rivers they navigate.

Scenic—celebrated for its innovative fleet of 'Space-Ships'—embraces sleek, contemporary luxury with state-of-the-art technology. Signature features include private butler service for every single stateroom category, revolutionary all-weather 'Scenic Sun Lounge' glass balconies, and up to five distinct dining venues per ship.

quickAnswer.title: Quick Verdict: Which Cruise Line Should You Choose?
quickAnswer.quote: If you prioritize antique European palace elegance, bespoke boutique interiors, and royal butler pampering in top suites, choose Uniworld. If you want sleek contemporary styling, butler service included in every single cabin category, and revolutionary all-weather Sun Lounge balconies, choose Scenic.
quickAnswer.author: Angela Hughes

atAGlance.title: At a Glance: Uniworld vs. Scenic
rows: Uniworld features one-of-a-kind boutique palace styling; Scenic delivers sleek, contemporary five-star hotel design.
Scenic includes dedicated butler service for every stateroom on the ship; Uniworld provides butlers for top suites.
Scenic's revolutionary 'Sun Lounge' converts private balconies into glass-enclosed conservatories with push-button ease.
Uniworld's museum-quality original art, handcrafted fabrics, and bespoke ship identities are unmatched on the river.
Both deliver farm-to-table regional cuisine; Scenic offers up to 5 venues including Portobello and Table La Rive.
Scenic includes 100% of excursions, all minibar items, all gratuities, e-bikes, and airport transfers seamlessly.
Uniworld features handcrafted Savoir of England beds; Scenic features custom ergonomic 'Slumber Beds' with pillow menus.
Uniworld sails the Nile, Mekong, Ganges, and Amazon in addition to Europe; Scenic sails Europe, Southeast Asia, and ocean yachts.
Both represent the gold standard in five-star ultra-luxury river cruising.

faqs.question: Is Uniworld more luxurious than Scenic?
faqs.answer: Both are ultra-luxury river cruise lines operating at the highest level of European travel. Uniworld is known for boutique palace elegance with handcrafted antique furnishings, while Scenic specializes in sleek contemporary styling, all-weather Sun Lounge balconies, and universal butler service.

faqs.question: Is Scenic more expensive than Uniworld?
faqs.answer: Scenic's upfront fares can be slightly higher because virtually 100% of onboard and onshore expenses—including butler service in every suite, all minibar restocks, e-bikes, and airport transfers—are included in the initial fare.

faqs.question: Which cruise line includes gratuities?
faqs.answer: Both Uniworld and Scenic include all onboard gratuities on European itineraries, ensuring zero unexpected tipping requests.

faqs.question: Which has better food and dining?
faqs.answer: Both provide exceptional gourmet dining. Uniworld focuses on destination-inspired farm-to-table cuisine, while Scenic offers up to five distinct dining venues per ship, including Portobello Italian and Table La Rive private degustation.

faqs.question: Which cruise line has better shore excursions?
faqs.answer: Scenic offers its flexible Scenic Freechoice program plus exclusive Scenic Enrich after-hours palace events. Uniworld offers its curated Masterpiece Collection of cultural and culinary experiences.

faqs.question: Are alcoholic beverages included on both?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both include unlimited sommelier-selected fine wines, craft beers, cocktails, and premium spirits throughout the voyage at any time.

faqs.question: Which cruise line provides butler service?
faqs.answer: Scenic provides dedicated butler service for every stateroom on the ship, regardless of cabin grade. Uniworld provides butler service for top suite categories.

faqs.question: What is the Scenic Sun Lounge?
faqs.answer: It is Scenic's proprietary balcony system featuring a floor-to-ceiling glass window that retracts at the push of a button, converting your private balcony into an all-weather enclosed conservatory.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included on Uniworld and Scenic?
faqs.answer: Yes. High-speed complimentary Wi-Fi is included throughout the ships on both cruise lines.

faqs.question: Which is better for couples and romance?
faqs.answer: Both are exceptional for romance. Uniworld delivers candlelit boutique intimacy and antique chateau charm, while Scenic offers private balcony lounging and spacious contemporary suites.

faqs.question: Which cruise line offers more worldwide destinations?
faqs.answer: Uniworld offers an extensive worldwide portfolio including Egypt (Nile), India (Ganges), Peru (Amazon), and Southeast Asia (Mekong), alongside Europe. Scenic sails Europe and Southeast Asia on rivers, plus worldwide expedition ocean cruising.
